offer_title: Alfa Romeo summer offer 2019: range from QR 109,000 with 5-year/120,000 km service and warranty
status_reason: Campaign published August 2019; no 2026 Alfa Romeo campaign found. drivearabia lists no official Alfa Romeo dealer in Qatar as of 2026.
